title: VoxelWise Toolbox
description: A lightweight, dependency-free MATLAB library for human fMRI analysis. All brain data is held in a single fixed layout—the 228,453 in-brain voxels of the 91×109×91 MNI152 2 mm template—so the analysis functions compose freely with one another, with no wrapping or format conversion. Aimed particularly at continuous-feature and naturalistic paradigms, where the discrete-event assumptions of conventional designs do not hold.
notes: If you use this toolbox, please cite both the software and the paper.
